findings.title: Incomplete JSON escaping in json_escape function
findings.detail: The json_escape function only escapes backslashes and double quotes. It does not handle newlines, tabs, carriage returns, or other control characters, which could corrupt the JSON payload or allow structural injection if message contains such characters.

findings.title: Non-portable bash syntax: shift and parameter expansion
findings.detail: The script uses 'shift' (a ksh/zsh builtin, not POSIX bash) and '${var:?message}' error-on-unset expansion (ksh93 feature). This will cause runtime failures in standard bash environments.

evidence.excerpt: shift 2 ;;\n    --webhook) WEBHOOK="${2:?--webhook needs a URL}"; shift 2 ;;

findings.title: Silent curl with no error handling
findings.detail: curl runs with -s (silent) and output redirected to /dev/null. Network failures, HTTP errors, or server-side rejections are completely unobserved, making operational debugging impossible.
